items.title: Is Prologis (PLD) Below Fair Value After Its $5b ATM Offering?
items.summary: Prologis (PLD) has moved back into the equity market, filing a US$5b at-the-market follow-on offering and immediately placing US$71.8m of common stock with investors. That equity raise drops into a stock that has been treading water in the shorter term, with a 1 month share price return of 0.82% and a 90 day share price decline of 6.42%. items.title: Prologis (PLD) Forms Joint Venture To Redevelop Former Joliet Casino Site
items.summary: Prologis (NYSE:PLD) has formed a joint venture with Gaming and Leisure Properties, Inc. to redevelop the former Hollywood Casino Joliet site. The partners plan to turn the Illinois property into a large-scale warehouse and distribution park aimed at modern logistics users. The project marks Gaming and Leisure Properties, Inc.'s first move into the industrial and logistics real estate sector.
